passage.text: This week, English class starts at half past eight on Monday.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈwiːk, ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌklæs ˈstɑːrts ət ˈhæf ˈpæst ˈeɪt ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ.

passage.text: On Wednesday, it starts at a quarter past one.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ, ɪt ˈstɑːrts ət ə ˈkwɔːrtər ˈpæst ˈwʌn.
ˈnoʊ ˈklæs ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈeɪprəl ˈsɪksθ!

passage.text: The next class is on Monday, April 9th.
passage.reading: ðə ˈnɛkst ˈklæs ɪz ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ˈeɪprəl ˈnaɪnθ.
